name: Vega
source:
Vega is a traveler, venturing out into the galaxy for the first time after spending her life sheltered in her home planetary system. After her ship breaks down, she decides to stay on the Hesperides for a while while she waits for repairs.

She's bubbly and kind, though naive. But there are holes in the stories she tells about her past that make you question just how truthful she's being.

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/330388878/love-at-the-milky-way-diner/description]Kickstarter[/url]]
